verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a package manager, not an AI agent or LLM host, so acting as an MCP client that uses other servers' tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Homebrew connecting to or consuming MCP servers; its taps, Brewfile and JSON API features are package-management capabilities, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
